result.question: Where did the man of God go after the old prophet lied to him?

readings.support: went back with him | in his house

assessments.reason: Verse 19 says the man of God "went back with him" and ate and drank "in his house," indicating he went back to the old prophet’s house.

result.reason: The text states he went back with the old prophet and was in the old prophet’s house.
